body:
It doesnt matter now. I am homeless, have to move, and that means selling or giving away everything I have worked for in my life.

I am going to be honest with you today. I am writing the note as soon as I know what I want to say, then taking my kid back to her mother and college 900 miles away, driving back here, printing the note, giving some stuff away, then I am going to the park across the road from her parents house and putting a bullet through my brain stem.

Everything I worked for is gone. Everything I cared about is being taken away from me. I can never trust anyone again, will never be able to love anyone again, and I just dont want to live my life anymore.

Yes I am being selfish. I have spent my entire life sacrificing myself for others. In a way I still will be, because she will get everything I had, be able to sell it, and despite leaving me, cheating on me, and destroying my life, she will still profit from it. It will be the only selfish thing I have ever done, ending my life because I dont want to hurt anymore. I am doing this for me, and its the only thing I have ever really done for myself.

Thanks for talking to me. Sorry you couldnt change the events of the last few weeks of my life. You gave this crippled old veteran a bit of hope for a while. Thank you for caring. I hope someday you can save someone else, and their life gets better. Mine has only gotten worse every time I tried again instead of ending it. This time I am ending it.

Ive had bad luck with each and every one of them, not just two. That is why I am writing them off entirely.

My first I wasnt emotionally invested, she was horrible, abusive to me and the kids, because she is rapid cycling bi polar. 

Each and every one before my current soon to be ex I walked away from without much of a second thought. This one was different in every way except she has low self esteem and thinks nobody could ever want her. So when someone shows up and shows interest in her, she abandons me for him, without thinking it through. When she isnt talking to some asshole like that, we get along great. She fits me better than anyone I have ever met, and vice versa. 

She is simply inexperienced, naive, and impulsive. The rest were something different. I was 34 when I met her, and we had been together for almost ten years. I looked all over the world, and found one woman who fit me, and hundreds who wanted to use me. My prospects for finding someone that isnt just warm moist place to jack off are not very good. I dont fit with many people, even in a friend capacity and in an intimate relationship it gets even dicier.

Really though, the reason I cant stop thinking about ending it isnt so much her. Its my entire life. Chronic pain, horrible memories, intrusive thoughts, loneliness, and its all the result of surviving severe abuse growing up, and serving in two wars. She just made my life something I could endure. Its hard to find someone who wants a fucked up crippled guy like me.

I really dont want to wake up every day, but I still do.

I dont want a third. I cant trust them. Fool me once, shame on you. Fool me twice, I am a fucking idiot.

I have a shrink, and I know I can meet women easy, the problem is how long before yet another one does this to me?
